text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school, I saw Nishino Flower and the others
studying in the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san. This problem says,
"Find the value of x," correct?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that means you can
rearrange the equation into the form of x = !

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Wait, huh?
Now I'm even more confused...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Like I said, x equals 3!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Why does it end up like that?
In the first place, why does 'x' move to the left side?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean...
If I don't do that, I won't get an answer, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What, Mayano,
you don't understand either, do you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I already know that!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um... err, how should I explain this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, we were doing our homework together,
but I don't know how to explain the math...
choice_data_list: How did you figure that out?
How did you come to understand that?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What I heard in class was...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, right!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I took notes for all the classes,
so please feel free to use them as a reference!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see!
The plus and minus were swapped right here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What's this, it's just simple addition and subtraction!
This'll be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, these are some awesome notes.
They're way easier to understand than class, seriously!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! The colors are so pretty,
it's really fun just looking at this notebook~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all, I'm merely copying down the blackboard
while listening to the lecture.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Maya takes pictures too, but they're never this pretty! How do you do it~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There's nothing special about it at all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I simply try my best to write neatly so that anyone other than myself can understand it, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I figured that if I wrote it down carefully,
it would help me out when I look back on it later.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehe! But Maya and the others were the ones who got saved, though★

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's true.
From now on, I need to write with enough care
so that I can help everyone even more.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now whenever I'm in trouble,
I can just check Flower's notes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You can't just rely on others all the time!
You've gotta study by yourself too~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's totally fine.
If you ever get stuck, just ask anytime!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: We all help each other out in times of need, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~♪ Flower-chan just now
felt kinda like a big sister~★

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
Ehehe, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, no, this is all thanks to your advice, Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your diligence.
It's all thanks to your diligence.
Let me know if you ever need any help.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, no, this is all thanks to your advice, Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your diligence.
It's all thanks to your diligence.
Let me know if you ever need any help.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? Wow...!
Hearing you say that makes me... so happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll keep studying even harder from now on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I've got to take proper notes tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But relying on you all the time
would be bad, so I'll keep it in moderation.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it, we're in this together when times are tough.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you very much!
I'll be counting on you from now on as well!
